sourceRoster.description: Reusable fantasy location archetypes for D&D-style adventures. Frequency tiers are editorial estimates, not measured campaign statistics. Named campaign-specific places can extend this catalog.

artDirection.normal: Original cinematic painterly fantasy environment illustration, believable materials and architecture, wide establishing shot, readable at small display sizes. The location is the subject; any inhabitants are incidental and do not imply a specific party or encounter. No text, labels, UI, map grid, collage, borders, logos or watermark.
artDirection.yolo: Same environment illustration style and recognizable location type, with an original absurd dark-comedy visual twist. Describe the visible joke explicitly in the variant description. No meme captions, text, UI, map grid, collage, borders, logos or watermark.

selectionGuidance: Match the scene to a location ID using its English description and tags.
Use normal variants by default. Use yolo variants only when the caller explicitly requests that tone.
Choose only existing entries in variants; target counts and pending locations are not available artwork.
Then match the variant's English description, tags, lighting and mood to the current scene.
Join assetBaseUrl with the selected variant's relative path. Keep the existing fallback when no suitable generated variant is available.
